claims: As of mid-March 2026, SpaceX has completed over 30 launches early in the year.
As of mid-March 2026, SpaceX maintains weekly Falcon 9 Starlink missions from Florida and California.
A Starlink Mission using Falcon 9 is scheduled from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 16, 2026.
A Starlink Mission using Falcon 9 is scheduled from Cape Canaveral SFS on March 18, 2026.
Artemis II Crewed Lunar Mission using Falcon Heavy (NASA) is scheduled for April 2026 (NET April 6).
ViaSat-3 F3 using Falcon Heavy is scheduled from Kennedy Space Center in April 2026.
MRV-1 Mission is scheduled from Cape Canaveral in May 2026.
SDA Tranche 1 Tracking Layer is scheduled from Vandenberg SFB in June 2026.
Griffin Mission One using Falcon Heavy is scheduled from Kennedy Space Center in July 2026.
Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II uses a SpaceX Falcon Heavy for training and validation.
Artemis II has a critical window in April 2026.
SpaceX plans weekly Starlink launches throughout 2026 to build the Gen2 constellation.
Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is scheduled for launch in September 2026.
